subject: Verification of an active micro-payment contributor program and opportunity cost

source_verified_facts.claim: Official maintainer's September 2026 report states 207 merged PRs from 98 authors, 76 authors received rewards, and average rewarded PR was 0.51 USDC; this is a maintainer report, not our processor receipt.
Maintainer announced Avalanche support in paid data program from Oct 10 to at least Nov 1 and replacement of Somnia with Fuse on Nov 1.
Maintainer asked certain contributors to supply receiving addresses for recorded pending rewards; payment is not automatically guaranteed without correct payout details.
Maintainer reported review backlog of over 600 PRs and possible significant wait.

assessment.payment_evidence: public maintainer-reported actual contributor rewards, but no direct verified payment to this venture
assessment.buyer: open source project maintainers publicly solicit database improvements
assessment.deliverability: verified data contribution requires meaningful manual quality control, upstream PR, and verified receiving wallet address; no authorized fork-and-PR path established in current connected tool
assessment.terms: 0.06 USDC per approved added cell; 0.1 per image; review and quality gates; low average actual payout and backlog
assessment.competition: 98 authors, 207 merged PRs in September; active competition
assessment.expected_utility: poor compared with time for careful data verification; not presently worth a submission without established payout route
assessment.action_taken: verified official program terms and payouts and ruled out low-ROI submission
assessment.reason_no_outreach: No identified buyer-specific, reasonably compensated, deliverable request with an accessible supported submission route. Do not spam a maintainer with non-contribution inquiry.

editorial_finding: A real contributor payment program exists, but documented typical reward size and backlog challenge the assumption that verified paying demand automatically creates a viable business. This is distinct from generic unfunded bounty scans.
public_safety: No user, customer, private inbox, related brands, payment addresses, or proprietary data for documentary.
